title: AMD fiscal Q3 2026 results (after the close; call 5 p.m. ET) — the nearest AI-GPU peer print, 11 trading days before the NVDA print
source: IR: AMD's own press release 'AMD to Report Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results' (ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1300/), released 2026-10-06 4:15 pm EDT and re-fetched direct 2026-10-18 by this event's own initial research (the proposing sibling lane, nvda-2026-11-18-print, read the same page): 'will report fiscal third quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, after the market close... conference call to discuss these results at 5 p.m. ET / 2 p.m. PT'. Promoted estimate -> confirmed 2026-10-18 on the company's own announcement, two independent direct reads. One aggregator (tradingpedia, 2026-10-05) printed Nov 2 with no source; the IR page wins
notes: Discovered during the nvda-2026-11-18-print pulse (2026-10-18). Not an earnings-calendar entry, so it is a sector-kind event rather than a derived print. Same date as the US midterm elections. AMD was -18.6% over the 8-session chip losing streak ending 2026-10-16, so the print lands into a de-risked tape; its read-through for NVDA is AI-accelerator demand and the neocloud financing question.
